name: DaBai
summary: DaBai is an older Orbbec depth camera using the OpenNI device protocol. The manufacturer lists it in the Orbbec SDK v1 compatibility table and marks it as planned for discontinuation in its current camera catalog. It belongs to the depth-camera ecosystem used for embedded robotics; DCW, DW and Pro variants have separate records.

driver
: Windows device driver for OpenNI protocol devices (Dabai, Dabai DCW, Dabai DW, Astra mini Pro, Astra Pro Plus, A1 Pro, Gemini E, Gemini E Lite, Gemini). While modules that use the standard UVC protocol do not need to install drivers.
